about: kyty-triage rules. scope: fatal = matched against the message of a fatal report (with 'file' as a basename condition), line = matched against every log line (needs a literal ^prefix in 'regex', or 'prefix'/'contains'), meta = used by the tool's own extractors (no regex). Fatal rules are tried in file order; the first match wins. severity 0-100 ranks fix areas. See README.md.

rules.title: Unresolved import called with --strict-imports
rules.next_step: Implement the named function (LIB_FUNC in the library's src/libs file, or a new LIB_VERSION block). Rerun without --strict-imports to see how far the game gets with the offline-style stub result.

rules.title: Unsupported shader instruction (fatal)
rules.regex: unsupported decoded instruction|shader CFG build failed|unknown RDNA2 instruction family|unsupported scalar (?:source|destination) operand|opcode \S+ at pc 0x[0-9a-f]+ has unsupported|shader function needs nested calls|unsupported family=\w+ opcode=
rules.next_step: Add the opcode to the decoder table and translate it (frontend/decode/*Ops.cpp, frontend/translate/*.cpp) with a GPU test in tests/ShaderRecompilerComputeTests.cpp. For more shaders, rerun with --shader-log-direction File to dump the program.

rules.title: Shader resource tracking failed
rules.regex: shader resource tracking: hash=0x(?P<hash>[0-9a-f]{16}) stage=(?P<stage>\w+)|indirect image table at pc 0x[0-9a-f]+ has incompatible candidates
rules.next_step: Get the shader dump (--shader-log-direction File) for the hash, find the instruction at pc that loads the descriptor, and teach ResourceTracking where the value comes from (descriptor table index, LoadBufferU32, GPU-selected V#).

rules.title: SPIR-V emission or validation failed
rules.next_step: Dump the module (--shader-log-direction File), run spirv-val on it and fix the emitter for the reported opcode.

rules.title: Pipeline creation failed in the driver
rules.next_step: Note the stage hashes, dump them with --shader-log-direction File and run spirv-val; on NVIDIA also try without --shader-cache (#2069).
known: 173922b2 names the VkResult and stage hashes (cruz)
#2069 NVIDIA driver segfault during parallel shader-cache warm-up

rules.title: Out of GPU memory
rules.regex: ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory|ErrorOutOfHostMemory|failed to create image: extent=|vmaCreateAllocator failed|out of device memory
rules.next_step: Rerun with --vram-profile low (and --oom-recovery) on the 8 GB card; attach the 'VRAM:' and 'VRAM spill:' lines. Check the eviction thresholds in renderer/cache/memoryPolicy.h.

rules.title: GPU device lost (named)
rules.next_step: A GPU hang or TDR. Rerun with --vulkan-validation (on NVIDIA look for VUID-*-06479) and --device-fault-report; on Windows check Event Viewer (nvlddmkm 153 / amdkmdag). Bisect the last draw/dispatch with the shader hashes logged before it.
known: #1498 Astro Bot device lost on RTX 5070

rules.title: Descriptor pool exhausted or rejected
rules.regex: descriptor set does not fit a pool|createDescriptorPool|fresh_batch|ErrorOutOfPoolMemory|ErrorFragmentedPool
rules.next_step: Mostly AMD (driver bug #1624 item 11). Compare with cruz fdec6ff6 and upstream PR #1758; log the requested pool sizes.
known: #829 GTA V Fidelity/Perf RT on AMD

rules.title: GPU device lost (reported as 'Not implemented (result != eSuccess)')
rules.next_step: A GPU hang or TDR (Windows Event Viewer: nvlddmkm 153 on NVIDIA, amdkmdag on AMD). Rerun with --vulkan-validation (on NVIDIA look for VUID-*-06479) and --device-fault-report; the shader hashes logged just before the report point at the last dispatch.

rules.title: Vulkan validation error (fatal with --vulkan-validation)
rules.next_step: Look up the VUID; the call named before it (vkCmdDraw*/vkCmdDispatch) and the binding identify the resource. Fix the binding, not the validation callback.
known: #1476/#1458 VUID-*-06479 R32_SFLOAT with a depth-compare sampler (NVIDIA)

rules.title: No usable Vulkan device
rules.next_step: The listed features are missing on this GPU/driver (MoltenVK lacks minLod, shaderBufferInt64Atomics, shaderCullDistance). Update the driver; otherwise make the feature optional with a fallback.

rules.title: Invalid depth upload in the texture cache
rules.next_step: Check the image layer count / format of the depth target being uploaded (a 6-layer cube through a view of fewer slices in GTA V).

rules.title: Depth attachment feedback loop not supported by the host
rules.regex: depth attachment feedback loop is not supported
rules.next_step: Sample a pre-draw copy of the depth target instead of exiting.

rules.title: Unsupported storage image or texture
rules.regex: unsupported storage color image resource|unsupported storage texture
rules.next_step: Add the view kind/dimension (kind=11 dimension=3 is a 3D storage view in GTA V story load).

rules.title: Unsupported texture-tiled render target view
rules.next_step: Support the layered view of the tiled target.

rules.title: Unsupported depth render state
rules.regex: unsupported render state; details were printed above|Depth target fatal
rules.next_step: The 'Depth target fatal:' line before the report says which state; support it or fall back.

rules.title: Unknown PM4 shader register
rules.next_step: Add the register to the PM4 SH register handlers.

rules.title: PageManager fatal
rules.next_step: Write-watch bookkeeping went wrong; the message names the range and mode.

rules.title: Guest memory mapping failure
rules.regex: ^Memory: |direct-backing write failed|could not reserve \d+ MB for guest direct memory|BufferCache: failed to read sparse
rules.next_step: Check the host RAM / commit limit (#829 13824 MB commit) and the mapping that failed.

rules.title: Guest called abort()
rules.next_step: Read 'Guest abort diagnostics' and the guest stack trace in the printf log; the caller usually checked a return value of an HLE function.

rules.title: Uncaught C++ exception (std::terminate)
rules.next_step: The what() text names the throwing code; on Windows the exit code is 0xC0000409 or 3.

rules.title: Fatal error in an HLE library
rules.next_step: Turn the EXIT into a logged soft failure that returns the documented error code (Soft-fail helper on the gta6/hle branch), then see what the game does next.

rules.title: Fatal error in the kernel emulation
rules.next_step: Turn the EXIT into an error return the guest can handle, or implement the missing case.

rules.title: Guest code faulted (unhandled host exception in a guest module)
rules.next_step: Resolve the pc to module+offset (done above when the log has the module map) and look at what the guest read before: a stub that returned 0, an unmapped buffer, or a red-zone clobber. Rerun with --printf-direction File so the module map and import calls are in the log.
known: #729/#888 GTA V 01.005 eboot+0x28ab5xx..dxx write fault on NVIDIA

rules.title: Guest jumped to a null or bad address
rules.next_step: Usually a function pointer read from an unresolved object import or a zeroed struct an HLE call should have filled. Check the unresolved object imports and the last HLE calls.

rules.title: Crash inside the GPU driver
rules.next_step: If 'pipeline being created by the driver' names stages, dump and spirv-val those shaders; update the driver; on NVIDIA try without --shader-cache (#2069) and with the pipeline helpers.

rules.title: Crash in the emulator or a host library
rules.next_step: Get a symbolized stack (Windows: a .dmp with the matching .pdb; Linux: gdb) for the host pc.

rules.title: Unhandled host exception at a host address (module unknown)
rules.next_step: The pc is outside the guest modules. Rerun a build with fc3a6c82 (names the DLL) or attach a debugger; a near-null address is a null dereference in the emulator or driver.
known: #1123 host null read pc=0x7ff9fec0e9cd addr=0x350 on the pause menu

rules.title: Fatal error (no specific rule)
rules.next_step: Open the file named in the report at that line; add a rule to tools/triage/rules.json once the cause is known.

rules.title: Unresolved imports called at run time
rules.next_step: Implement the called functions (LIB_FUNC with a plausible result); check what the game does with the stub's return value. 'policy=' shows the stub's current return.
known: gta6/hle: once-per-symbol logging, offline Np/Net returns, --strict-imports

rules.title: Imports left unresolved at load
rules.next_step: Not a failure by itself; the ones that get called matter. Use --dump-imports on the game's eboot to diff against GTA V.

rules.title: Shader skipped: unsupported instruction
rules.next_step: The draw/dispatch of these shaders is skipped, so their output is missing. Implement the opcode; --strict-shaders restores the old fatal error for a reproducer.
known: gta6/shader-alu: skip unsupported programs instead of exiting

rules.title: Vulkan validation errors
rules.next_step: Fix the first VUID in the run; later ones are often follow-ons.

rules.title: Vulkan validation warnings
rules.next_step: Usually performance hints; ignore unless they name a hazard.

rules.title: Workarounds applied ([HACK])
rules.next_step: Each [HACK] hides a missing feature; a hack that fires every frame near the failure is a suspect.

rules.title: HLE soft failures (former fatal errors)
rules.next_step: These used to EXIT; the game got an error code instead. Implement the case if the game reacts badly.

rules.title: Raw syscall instructions in guest code
rules.next_step: Raw syscalls are not emulated; find which syscall numbers the module uses and route them to the kernel HLE.
known: gta6/hle: raw syscall detection at load

rules.title: Log ends during the shader cache warm-up (NVIDIA)
rules.next_step: Known NVIDIA driver segfault in parallel warm-up; rerun without --shader-cache.

rules.title: No fatal report: hang, kill or crash outside the handler
rules.next_step: Ask for the console output, the session log (--session-log) and the Windows Event Viewer entry; a hang shows as the last lines repeating.

rules.title: Log cut off mid-line (killed, hang or still running)
rules.next_step: The process was killed or hung; ask for the session log, which is flushed per line, and what was on screen.

rules.title: Vulkan validation VUID
rules.next_step: Fix the first VUID of the run; the call and binding in the message identify the resource.

rules.title: Vulkan call returned ErrorDeviceLost
rules.next_step: See the device-lost rule.

rules.title: Vulkan call ran out of memory
rules.next_step: Rerun with --vram-profile low --oom-recovery; attach the VRAM lines.

rules.title: Vulkan call failed
rules.next_step: Look up the VkResult for the named call.

rules.title: VK_EXT_device_fault report
rules.next_step: The fault address / vendor code narrows the dispatch; match the address against the buffer and image ranges.

rules.title: Allocations spilled out of device-local memory
rules.regex: ^VRAM spill: (?P<kind>images|buffers) allocated outside device-local memory: count=(?P<count>\d+) bytes=(?P<mib>\d+) MiB
rules.next_step: The working set exceeds VRAM: expect stutter. Try --vram-profile low and compare the 'VRAM:' budget line with the card size; the GC thresholds live in renderer/cache/memoryPolicy.h on the gta6/vram branch.

rules.title: Emergency eviction after an allocation failure
rules.regex: ^VRAM pressure: emergency eviction freed (?P<freed>\d+) MiB after allocation failure of (?P<mib>\d+) MiB \((?P<what>.*?)\), retry (?P<retry>\d+)
rules.next_step: Allocation failures were recovered by eviction; lower the texture budget (--vram-profile low, thresholds in renderer/cache/memoryPolicy.h on gta6/vram).

rules.title: Image creation failed
rules.next_step: Check the VMA heap lines before it for budget vs usage.

rules.title: VMA heap budget dump
rules.next_step: Context for an allocation failure.

rules.title: Host could not reserve guest direct memory
rules.regex: ^could not reserve (?P<mb>\d+) MB for guest direct memory
rules.next_step: Host RAM or page-file limit; raise the page file or close other programs.

rules.title: Descriptor set does not fit its pool
rules.regex: ^descriptor set does not fit a pool sized for it:
rules.next_step: See the descriptor-pool rule.

rules.title: Pipeline creation failed
rules.next_step: Dump the named stage hashes and run spirv-val.

rules.title: Driver was compiling a pipeline
rules.next_step: If the crash is in the driver, these are the shaders to dump.

rules.title: Pipeline helper process problem
rules.next_step: A helper process failed to compile; the named cs hash is the shader.

rules.title: SPIR-V validation failed
rules.next_step: Dump the module and run spirv-val.

rules.title: SPIR-V emission/validation failed
rules.next_step: Dump the module and run spirv-val.

rules.title: Shader resource specialization failed
rules.next_step: Non-fatal; the draw used a generic path. Frequent lines near a crash point at the shader.

rules.title: Indirect image table with incompatible candidates
rules.regex: ^indirect image table at pc 0x(?P<pc>[0-9a-f]+) has incompatible candidates
rules.next_step: The bindless table mixes image kinds.

rules.title: GPU missing an optional feature
rules.regex: ^WARNING: Your GPU is not fully supported \((?P<what>[^)]*)\)
rules.next_step: Rendering that needs the feature falls back or is wrong.

rules.title: Format lacks storage support
rules.regex: ^Warning: format (?P<format>\w+) does not support storage access
rules.next_step: Block-compressed textures written by the guest will not render.

rules.title: Formatted buffer access read or written as raw DWORDs
rules.regex: ^Shader: formatted buffer (?P<dir>load|store) with unsupported format (?P<format>\d+) falls back to raw DWORDs \(first in shader 0x(?P<hash>[0-9a-f]{16})\)
rules.next_step: The shader moves untranslated bytes for this V# format; wrong colours or geometry from that buffer point here. Add the format to the formatted buffer conversion.

rules.title: Depth target fatal detail
rules.next_step: The reason for the following 'unsupported render state' report.

rules.title: Depth feedback loop notice
rules.regex: ^depth attachment feedback loop is not supported by the host
rules.next_step: Non-fatal in current builds; may show as wrong depth effects.

rules.title: GPU accessed memory that is not GPU-cached
rules.next_step: A shader read memory no buffer covers; it read zeros.

rules.title: Guest memory access problem
rules.regex: ^Memory: (?P<what>attempted to access invalid address|required direct-backing write failed)
rules.next_step: The guest touched unmapped memory; check the mapping calls before it.

rules.title: Sparse guest buffer read failed
rules.regex: ^BufferCache: failed to read sparse guest buffer memory
rules.next_step: A GPU buffer covers unmapped guest pages.

rules.title: Unknown PM4 shader register
rules.next_step: Add the register.

rules.title: Indirect draw ignores GE_INDX_OFFSET
rules.next_step: Geometry of indirect indexed draws may be wrong.

rules.title: Session log could not be opened
rules.next_step: Check the --session-log path is writable.

known_signatures.note: GTA V compute shader, pc 0x93c GetBufferResource dword 0 (PPSA04263 1.010.002 and PPSA04264); no fix upstream
GTA V Fidelity skinning compute feeding the RT BVH, pc 0x86c; fixed in cruz 0490d330 (PR #931, IndirectWriteTables)
GTA V pixel shader, pc 0xc8 GetSamplerResource dword 3 (sampler border color word); fixed in cruz 3df1cd6b (PR #1226)
GTA V BVH compute shader behind the RADV ring gfx timeout
GTA V glyph atlas compute (FLAT_LOAD_UBYTE from DMA bases); cruz 82ca24cb caches DMA bases
GTA V 01.005 prologue guest write fault family on NVIDIA 8 GB cards (plausible, unconfirmed: red-zone clobber)
VideoRecording call seen in every GTA V log; harmless
depth-compare sampler on an R32_SFLOAT view; NVIDIA does not support it and hangs (TDR)
GTA V story-mode load storage image

library_hints.NpManager: PSN sign-in and account state; offline answers (not signed in, no account) keep games going (HLE policy np-offline).
library_hints.NpEntitlementAccess: DLC / entitlement checks; GTA V-style legacy labels are profile-gated on gta6/config.
library_hints.NpWebApi2: PSN web API; return a network error so the game takes its offline path.
library_hints.NpUniversalDataSystem: PSN telemetry/activities; can return success and drop data.
library_hints.NpTrophy2: Trophies; usually implemented as a local no-op.
library_hints.Ssl: TLS; return an error so the game stays offline.
library_hints.ContentExport: Share/export dialog; not needed to boot.
library_hints.PlayerInvitationDialog: PSN invitations; not needed to boot.
library_hints.SystemService: System events and parameters; check what the game reads.
library_hints.Json2: JSON library used by Np web APIs.
